detail_text: National Stock Numbers and their Item Descriptions: NSN Item Description 6130016592879 Battery Power Supply 6140016772079 Battery, Storage 6110016829466 Panel, Power Distribution 6130017184294 Battery Power Supply 6140017187499 Battery Assembly Maximum of the contract: $2,164,106.66 (1 Year) This item is being procured under the Statutory Authority 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1) - Available from only one or a limited number of sources, as implemented by FAR 6.302-1 Other Than Full and Open Competition - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The Product Identification Description (PID) list the only approved sources, which is Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Intellipower Cage code (0UMT8). The objective of this procurement is to place the item in a firm fixed price, indefinite delivery indefinite quantity (IDIQC) long-term contract (LTC) of a maximum of five (5) years, divided into a base period of one year 1-year) with no option periods. The total duration of the contract shall not exceed one (1) year. The Government will solicit the acquisition using FAR (Federal Acquisition Regulation) Part 15, Contracting by Negotiation. The scope of the procurement is limited to the one item listed in Section B of the solicitation. Interested persons may identify to the Contracting Officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government's requirement within 15 days of this notice. Unit of Order: Each (EA) Destination Information: CONUS Delivery Schedule: See solicitation. The solicitation will be available on the Internet at http://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/ on or about 5/22/2026. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Various Increments Solicited: see solicitation for price ranges. TYPE OF SET-ASIDE: None
